entries.title: MK Post Office- Giving Soldiers Comforts from Home (8313192).jpg
entries.description: U.S. Army Staff Sgt. Barry Burt, assigned to 467th Firefighter Engineer Detachment, helps unload the mail truck at the installation post office on Mihail Kogălniceanu Air Base, Romania, March 11, 2024. The post office receives mail three times a week after it is flown into Germany and then trucked for three days to MK Air Base where it is delivered to Soldiers there. ( U.S. Army photo by Spc. Joshua Maxie)

entries.title: Eastern Star Home LAT KYC 229.jpg
entries.description: Title: Know Your City No.229 Front grounds and façade of Eastern Star Home at 11725 Sunset Blvd. Los Angeles, Calif. Published caption: KNOW YOUR CITY, NO. 229 -- Here's one that will stump you. This lovely place is on a prominent boulevard and it is home to 59 ladies, all of whom, as you might suspect, belong to the same organization. Take a guess. See Page 26, Part ll. Publication: Los Angeles Times Publication date: July 4, 1956 Notes: ANSWER: The excellently landscaped establishment in the photo is the Eastern Star Home at 11725 Sunset Blvd. in Brentwood. Didn't you notice the star atop the entrance tower? The home, the only one of its kind in California, was built in 1933.
